meaning: Compose independent typed Workflow and effectful Operation references into exact finite execution expectations, compared with real generated Workflows using deferred run-local transaction ports.
construction_slice: R08ac3 execution composition and fixture foundation; generic finite-case coverage, effect audits, custody and public registration follow.
source_binding: Rebuild exact Workflow binding under its pinned definition. Pin the separate typed-value and metadata references. Do not accept caller-forged checked bindings or generated expected outcomes.
composition: Capture source input once; materialize each source occurrence's arguments from prior committed results; evaluate the independently checked Operation with explicit read/clock/settlement fixtures; classify its result independently; retain committed results only after commit evidence and typed capture. Stop on the first terminal outcome. Final and recovery argument materialization preserve existing selected source behavior.
observation: Run the unchanged compiled Workflow and Operations, without substituting imported modules. Observe actual begin/read/commit/rollback promises, read requests, submitted state-and-outbox batches and explicit clock calls. Port occurrence labels identify the controlled fixture slot, not proof that an unobserved callable was invoked. Typed argument correctness also requires the existing materialization and source/native import/AST checks.
settlement: Hold port promises and check that neither a successor port nor the Workflow return crosses an unsettled port. A thrown commit stays uncertain. Missing generated clock availability is per captured Operation dependency and must agree across repeated occurrences; other fixture outcomes can vary per occurrence. No production clock, store, dispatcher or compensation executor is created.
case_boundary: Cases are bounded inert JSON-shaped data with exact source occurrence coverage, explicit identities, supported Operation fixture modes and closed read/clock slots. Reject accessors, symbols, exotic prototypes, sparse arrays, unknown occurrence/slot/mode and malformed primitive fixture metadata before interpretation. Depth 128, 65536 values, at most 128 occurrences, at most 8 MiB serialized input. Invalid case metadata is distinct from an intentionally invalid source-input recipe.
outcomes: Entry rejection is observable without fabricated settlement evidence. Compare exact tagged values, independent evaluation and typed recovery bindings, port traces, batches and input/read custody. Tagged numeric carriers distinguish bigint from text. Freeze only owned expected values and native outputs; never mutate caller input except the explicit run-local capture adversary.
completion_boundary: Finite case composition and native fixtures do not enable public Workflow rows alone. Whole-node finite coverage, capacities, source/native effect audits, workspace currentness, mutation evidence and capsule registration remain required.
compatibility: Preserve existing product semantics, definitions, source capsule and predecessor source bytes. No new relationship, recovery default, runtime provider or operational authority.
claim_ceiling: Local candidate evidence, not universal proof, atomic-provider durability, admission, publication, release or CLI completion.
